note: Datasheet-class values are recorded with their source. OCV, resistance, RC terms and thermal values are provisional until bench tests T8 (OCV), T9 (pulse) and T12 (thermal) replace them. The UI shows a 'Provisional' badge while any field is not 'datasheet' or 'measured'. Sources disagree on some limits (see 'conflicts'); the most conservative value is used.

capacity_nominal_Ah.ref: DMEGC INR18650-26E via ANSMANN spec sheet for a pack built on this cell (Rapid 18-4194): 2600 mAh at 0.2C to 2.5 V

voltage_cutoff_V.ref: Same sheet: capacity measured to 2.5 V; ≥ 2.75 V recommended for long life

charge_current_max_A.ref: Same sheet: fast charge 2600 mA (1C); seller listings agree on 1C maximum

discharge_current_max_A.ref: DMEGC product page, 18650-26E: 7.8 A (3C) discharge cycle; sellers claim up to 15–30 A, not used

discharge_temperature_C.ref: ANSMANN sheet; avoid cell temperature above 60 °C

mass_g.ref: Seller listings (Rytronics); the ANSMANN pack weighs 52 g including its protection board

ocv_curve.ref: PyBaMM Chen2020 full-cell OCV (LG M50, NMC811/graphite-SiOx), a different NMC cell, windowed 2.5–4.2 V. Replace with T8. Expect tens of mV deviation.

r0_ohm.ref: No bare-cell impedance found in a manufacturer document (the ANSMANN ≤ 100 mΩ includes its protection board). Placeholder; identify with T9.

thermal.ref: Heat capacity from 45 g × ~1.0 J/(g·K); split and resistances follow the two-node structure of Biju & Fang (arXiv:2211.05999) for another 18650. Refit with T12.

conflicts.value: Maximum continuous discharge is quoted as 5 A (ANSMANN protected pack), 7.8 A (DMEGC), 13–30 A (sellers). Standard charge is quoted as 0.2C (ANSMANN) and 0.5C (sellers). This rig uses ≤ 1.25 A discharge and 2 A charge, inside every quoted limit.
